name: pi-byteplus-modelark-provider
description: Pi extension that exposes a BytePlus ModelArk Coding Plan subscription as a Pi provider (OpenAI Chat Completions wire). Discovers the plan's live model catalog, ships reasoning-effort support, and signs in through Pi's own /login flow instead of a hand-ex
